items.question: What is Happy Horse AI and how does it work?
items.answer: Happy Horse AI is a browser-based AI video platform. You can start from text, images, references, or an existing clip, then adjust workflow-specific settings before exporting the result.

items.question: Which workflows are available on the homepage?
items.answer: The main workflows are text to video, image to video, reference to video, and video edit. Each one exposes different upload options and settings based on the task.

items.question: What resolutions and aspect ratios are supported?
items.answer: Happy Horse AI currently supports 720p and 1080p output. Available aspect ratios include 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, and 3:4, depending on the workflow.

items.question: Can I upload reference images, videos, or voice?
items.answer: Yes. The reference-to-video workflow supports reference assets such as images, videos, a first frame, and voice input so you can better guide style and motion.

items.question: What can I change in the video edit workflow?
items.answer: You can upload an existing clip, describe the edit you want, choose a clip length preset, and decide whether to keep original audio or switch to AI audio.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Happy Horse AI uses credit-based plans. You can choose pay-as-you-go, monthly, or yearly options based on how often you generate videos and how much queue priority you need.

cta.title: Start with the workflow that fits your project
